newsitem.title: USA: Select not to buy Hightec,Sinclare stakes.
newsitem.headline: Select not to buy Hightec,Sinclare stakes.

text.p: MIAMI, July 25 (Reuter) 1997 - Select Capital Advisors Inc said Friday it cancelled plans to buy stakes in Hightec Inc and the Sinclare Group Inc.

"We were talking about a stake of 30 percent or so, but it wasn't really finalized," a Select spokeswoman said. "The details of the agreement weren't exactly what (the companies) had imagined they would be."

Hightec of Tiburon, Calif., bought a controlling interest in Sinclare of Montreal, Canada, in January. Hightec swapped one million of its shares for eight million shares of Sinclare (which had 15.8 million outstanding), and its president Larry Stokett became president of Sinclare.
Hightec's stock hit a 52-week low of 3/8 Thursday, while the bid on Sinclare's stock was $0.08 a share Friday, close to its 52-week low of $0.07.
